question: The possibility of errors is maximum in which of the following phase of SDLC ?
explanation: Most defects originate in the requirements/specification phase, because ambiguous or incomplete specifications spread errors into every later phase.

question: Cardinality in an Entity-Relationship diagram

options.A: refers to the number of higher level entities that are used in the ER model
options.B: is used to show the ratio of one entity in relationship to another entity
options.C: is used to show the order of the relationships between two entities
options.D: gives the count of the number of entities involved in a single relationship

explanation: Cardinality (cardinality ratio) gives how many instances of one entity relate to instances of another, e.g. 1:1, 1:N, M:N.

question: The ISO Quality Assurance Standard that applies to Software Engineering is
explanation: ISO 9001 covers design, development, production, installation and servicing, so it applies to software engineering (with guidance in ISO 9000-3).

question: Software engineering primarily aims on
explanation: Software engineering aims to produce reliable, high-quality software within budget and schedule, i.e. reliable and cost-effective software.

question: Software feasibility is based on which of the following :
explanation: Feasibility studies assess technical, economic (financial), schedule (time) and resource feasibility.

question: The division of system into components, processes and sub system is called
explanation: Breaking a system into components, processes and subsystems is called functional decomposition.

question: A turnkey project includes
explanation: A turnkey project delivers a complete ready-to-use system: hardware, software, installation and training.

question: The worst type of coupling is
explanation: Content coupling, where one module directly modifies or depends on another module's internals, is the highest and worst form of coupling.

question: CASE Tool is
explanation: CASE stands for Computer Aided Software Engineering.

question: Pseudocode can replace
explanation: Pseudocode and flowcharts both describe program logic, so pseudocode can be used instead of a flowchart.

question: Project Indicator enables a software project manager to

options.A: Assess the status of ongoing project
options.C: Uncover potential areas before they go critical

explanation: Project indicators help assess project status, track risks, find problem areas before they become critical, and adjust work flow.

question: Site for Alpha testing is
explanation: Alpha testing is done by users at the developer's site; beta testing is done at the customer's site.

question: Cohesion and Coupling can be represented using
explanation: Structure charts show modules and the data/control passed between them, which shows cohesion and coupling.

question: Black box testing is some time called ?
explanation: Black-box testing checks functional behaviour against requirements without looking at code, so it is also called behavioural testing.

question: The most important feature of spiral model is
explanation: Boehm's spiral model is risk-driven: each loop includes explicit risk analysis.

question: A COCOMO model is
explanation: COCOMO is Boehm's COnstructive COst MOdel for estimating effort and schedule.

question: The term HIPO is
explanation: HIPO (Hierarchical Input Process Output) is both a system analysis/design aid and a documentation technique.

question: Key process areas of CMM level 4 are also classified by a process which is
explanation: CMM levels are cumulative: an organisation at level 5 must satisfy all KPAs of level 4 (and lower), so level 4 KPAs also belong to level 5.

question: Which is not a Software Life Cycle Model ?
explanation: CMM is a process maturity framework, not a life-cycle model.

question: By metadata we mean
explanation: Metadata is data that describes other data.

question: A data dictionary has information about

options.A: every data element in a data flow
options.B: only key data element, in a data flow
options.C: only important data elements in a data flow
options.D: only numeric data elements in a data flow

explanation: A data dictionary defines every data element, data flow and data store in the system.

question: The term parallel run refers to

options.A: The same job run on two computers to test their speeds
options.B: The processing of two different jobs initiated from two terminals
options.C: The concurrent operations of existing system and the new system

explanation: In parallel conversion, the old and new systems run at the same time until the new one is shown to be reliable.

question: Tracing of any input record or process chronologically that has been performed on a system is an
explanation: An audit trail is a chronological record that lets each transaction be traced through the system.

question:
Good system design prevents data entry errors by
(i) Designing good forms with plenty of space to write in block capitals
(ii) By giving clear instructions to a user on how to fill a form
(iii) Reducing keystrokes of an operator
(iv) Designing good keyboard
explanation: Well-designed source forms with enough space and clear filling instructions prevent errors at the data-capture stage; keyboard design is not part of system design.

question: In interactive data input a menu is used to

options.C: select one out of many alternatives often by a mouse click

explanation: A menu presents a list of options so the user can pick one, often with a mouse click.

question: In a system flowchart, the manual data input is expressed by symbol of
explanation: Manual input is drawn with the slanted-top quadrilateral called the manual input (keyboard) symbol.

question: Decision tree uses
explanation: A decision tree uses nodes and branches to show alternative conditions and their resulting actions.

question: In interactive data input terminal commands are normally used to

options.C: select one out of many alternatives often by a mouse click

explanation: Terminal commands (such as ADD, DELETE) are typed to change records, i.e. to add or delete data.

question: A code is useful to represent a key field because

options.A: it is a concise representation of the field
options.B: it is usually done by all
options.C: it is generally a good idea
options.D: it is needed in database design

explanation: Codes give a short, unique, unambiguous representation of key fields, saving space and reducing entry errors.

question: Modularity

options.A: is a feature of all programming languages
options.B: helps make large programmes more understandable

explanation: Modularity splits a large program into independent units, making it easier to understand; not all languages support it directly.

question: Which of the following is a tool in design phase ?
explanation: Abstraction, stepwise refinement and information hiding are all basic design concepts.

question: Top-down design does not require
explanation: Top-down design uses stepwise refinement and modularity; loop invariants belong to program verification, not design.

question: In a decision table if there are 3 variables and 3 rules, it implies
explanation: Three binary conditions need 2^3 = 8 rules for completeness; having only 3 rules suggests the specification is incomplete.

question: A structured program

options.A: can be reduced to control structures
options.B: is generally more complicated than nonstructured program
options.C: can only be modified by the person who wrote it

explanation: By the Böhm–Jacopini theorem, a structured program can be expressed using only sequence, selection and iteration control structures.

question: Use of recursion

options.A: enhances logical clarity and reduces code size

explanation: Recursion often gives clearer and shorter code, but it usually costs execution time and stack space.

question: A desirable property of module is
explanation: Good modules are independent (high cohesion, low coupling).

question: The graph theoretic concept will be useful in software testing is
explanation: McCabe's cyclomatic number V(G) = E − N + 2 of the control-flow graph gives the number of independent paths to test.

question: When the ERASE command is used

options.B: the file name is deleted from the directories on the disk

explanation: ERASE/DEL removes the directory entry and frees the space, but the data stays on the disk until it is overwritten.

question: Control structures include
explanation: Control structures cover iteration and selection, and in languages such as Ada also rendezvous (task synchronisation) and exception handling.

question: All programming languages

options.B: can be supported by any operating system

explanation: Languages differ in syntax and compatibility and are not supported by every OS, so none of the statements is true.

question: TCP/IP is a:
explanation: TCP/IP is a suite of communication protocols.

question: Which is the lowest layer of TCP/IP model ?
explanation: The TCP/IP layers from bottom up are Network Access (Link), Internet, Host-to-Host (Transport) and Application.

question: Which IEEE standard is developed for CSMA/CD ?
explanation: IEEE 802.3 (Ethernet) uses CSMA/CD; 802.4 is token bus.

question: HTTP stands for
explanation: HTTP is HyperText Transfer Protocol.

question: What loads and executes at client side in Internet ?
explanation: A Java applet is downloaded and run in the client's browser; JSP runs on the server.

question: Keyword used for dynamic method resolution ?
explanation: In C++, declaring a function virtual makes calls to it resolve at run time (dynamic binding).

question: Class is

options.D: A template of object to be created

explanation: A class is a blueprint/template from which objects are created.

question: Which is the fastest port for data transfer ?
explanation: Among these, FireWire (IEEE 1394, up to 400/800 Mbps sustained) is fastest; serial and parallel ports are far slower.

question: Which IP address is reserved for loop back or local host ?
explanation: 127.0.0.1 is the standard loopback (localhost) address.

question: The size of the IPv4 is :
explanation: An IPv4 address is 32 bits; IPv6 is 128 bits.

question: Object oriented programming tends to achieve
explanation: Good OO design aims for highly cohesive classes with low coupling between them.

question: Signature of a method specifies

options.B: Return type, name and number of arguments

explanation: A method signature describes the method's name and parameter list (and, in the broader sense used here, its return type), not its body.

question: Polymorphism is achieved using
explanation: Method overloading gives compile-time polymorphism (overriding gives run-time polymorphism).

question: A condition that is caused by run-time error in program is known as
explanation: An exception is an abnormal condition raised during program execution.

question: Java applets are used to create ______ applications.
explanation: Applets give graphical and interactive content inside web pages.

question: Which of the following is not a primitive data type?
explanation: String is a class (reference type) in Java; byte, double and boolean are primitives.

question: Tool used to compile java code is
explanation: javac compiles .java source into .class bytecode; java runs it.

question: Superclass of all classes in java
explanation: java.lang.Object is the root of the Java class hierarchy.

question: What common technique attempts to save time and energy by reducing redundant work in object-oriented programming ?

options.C: Reduce size of systems being developed

explanation: Code reuse (through inheritance, composition and libraries) avoids rewriting existing work.

question: What term is used to describe the internal representation of an object that is hidden from view outside the object's definition?
explanation: Encapsulation bundles data with methods and hides the internal representation from outside code.

question: What part of object-oriented technology defines superclass and subclass relationships?
explanation: Inheritance creates the is-a relationship between a superclass and its subclasses.

question: JVM is able to access class having main method without creating any object because

options.A: main method is the first method to be declared
options.C: it makes explicit call to main method
options.D: main method is declared as public and static

explanation: main is public (accessible to the JVM) and static (callable on the class without an instance).

question: Unicode character set in java contains
explanation: A Java char is a 16-bit Unicode (UTF-16) code unit.

question: Which of the statements is true in a protected derivation of a derived class from a base class ?

options.A: Private members of the base class become protected members of the derived class
options.B: Protected members of the base class become public members of the derived class
options.C: Public members of the base class become protected members of the derived class
options.D: Protected derivation does not affect private and protected members of the derived class

explanation: In C++ protected inheritance, public and protected base members become protected in the derived class; private members stay inaccessible.

question: The keyword friend does not appear in

options.A: The class allowing access to another class
options.B: The class desiring access to another class
options.C: The private section of a class
options.D: The public section of a class

explanation: The friend declaration is written inside the class that grants access; the class receiving access does not use the keyword.

question: In which case is it mandatory to provide a destructor in a class ?

options.B: Class for which two or more than two objects will be created
options.C: Class for which copy constructor is defined
options.D: Class whose objects will be created dynamically

explanation: When objects (or their members) are allocated dynamically, a destructor is needed to free that memory and avoid leaks.

question:
Match the appropriate columns :
Columns I: a. Check style  b. JVM  c. Javadoc  d. Jdb
Columns II: I. declarations and documentation parser  II. debugger for java  III. coding standard  IV. abstract computer for java programs
explanation: Checkstyle enforces coding standards, the JVM is an abstract computer for Java programs, Javadoc parses declarations and doc comments, and jdb is the Java debugger.

question: In a switch block, each case statement is terminated by
explanation: break ends a case so control does not fall through to the next case.

question: Maximum number of template arguments in a function template is
explanation: A C++ template can take any number of template parameters.

question: Which of the following is example of encapsulation ?
explanation: A car as a whole bundles its components and hides their internal working behind a simple interface, which is encapsulation.

question: What is the difference between virtual functions and pure virtual functions ?

options.A: A virtual function must have a definition in the class in which it is declared. A pure virtual function does not provide a definition.
options.B: A virtual function does not provide a definition. A pure virtual function must have a definition in the class in which it is declared.

explanation: A virtual function has a body that derived classes may override; a pure virtual function (= 0) has no definition there and makes the class abstract.

question: An unconditional control structure is
explanation: goto transfers control without testing any condition.

question: What is NOT true about interfaces ?

options.B: There are no method bodies in interfaces
options.C: An interface is a reference type
options.D: Interfaces can be extended by other interfaces

explanation: An interface cannot be instantiated directly; it must be implemented by a class.

question: Which statements about the C# language are true ?

options.A: C# supports both procedural and object-oriented programming.
options.B: C# is only a procedural language.

explanation: C# supports procedural code (static methods, structured control flow) as well as full object-oriented programming.

question:
______ is a blueprint or prototype that defines the variables and the methods common to all objects of a certain kind.
Select the best word to complete this sentence.
explanation: A class defines the variables and methods common to all its objects.
this.a refers to the instance variable when a parameter or local variable shadows it.

question: In Java, 'new' keyword is used to
explanation: new allocates heap memory for an object and calls its constructor.

question: What is garbage collection in the context of Java?

options.A: The operating system periodically deletes all of the java files available on the system.
options.B: Any package imported in a program and not used is automatically deleted.
options.C: When all references to an object are gone, the memory used by the object is automatically reclaimed.
options.D: The JVM checks the output of any Java program and deletes anything that doesn't make sense.

explanation: The garbage collector automatically frees memory of objects that are no longer reachable.

question: Everything needs to be incorporated in classes in Java. So primitive variables (int, float) can be directly defined because
explanation: Each primitive has a wrapper class (Integer, Float, ...) that lets it be treated as an object when needed.

question: int occupies ______ bytes in java.
explanation: A Java int is always 32 bits (4 bytes), whatever the platform.

question: Which of these field declarations are legal within the body of an interface?
explanation: Interface fields are implicitly public static final and must be initialised; private is not allowed, (3) has no type, and (4) is not initialised.

question: A package is a collection of
explanation: A Java package groups related classes and interfaces.

question: << is a
explanation: << is the bitwise left-shift operator.

question: Which of the following variable declarations would NOT compile in a java program ?
explanation: Java identifiers cannot begin with a digit, so 1_var is illegal. (Option 4 as printed also lacks a semicolon; the intended answer is option 3.)

question: All exception types are subclasses of the built-in class
explanation: Throwable is the root of all exceptions and errors in Java.

question: Autoboxing is the term used for

options.A: Automatic conversion of primitive value to wrapper object
options.B: Automatic conversion of wrapper object to primitive value

explanation: Autoboxing automatically converts a primitive (e.g. int) into its wrapper object (Integer); the reverse is unboxing.

question: Which of these classes provide methods for writing binary representations of Java primitive values
explanation: DataOutputStream provides writeInt(), writeDouble() and similar methods that write primitives in binary form.

question: How many methods are defined in the Serializable interface ?
explanation: Serializable is a marker interface with no methods.

question: What is byte code in the context of Java?

options.A: The type of code generated by a Java compiler.
options.B: The type of code generated by a Java Virtual Machine.
options.C: It is another name for a Java source file.
options.D: It is the code written within the instance methods of a class.

explanation: javac compiles source code into platform-independent bytecode that the JVM executes.

question:
Which of the following JSP variables are not available within a JSP expression ?
Select the one correct answer.
explanation: JSP implicit objects include out, session and request; there is no implicit object named httpsession.

question: Which of the following is incorrect ?

options.A: Private variable will only be accessible in class
options.B: Protected can be accessible in non sub-class of another package
options.C: Protected member is accessible in sub-class of another package
options.D: Default can be used in another class of same package

explanation: Protected members are visible in the same package and in subclasses in other packages, but not in non-subclasses of other packages.

question: Which expression will extract the substring "cde" given the following declaration String str = "abcdef"
explanation: substring(begin, end) returns the characters from index begin to end − 1; indices 2 to 4 give "cde".

question: Which of the following is not true about Applet class ?

options.A: Package java.awt contains some superclass of applet
options.B: It can be viewed in browser
options.C: Using applet we cannot process graphics
options.D: Event handling can be used in applet

explanation: Applets can draw graphics (e.g. in paint(Graphics g)), so statement 3 is false.

question: Which of the following statements about Generics is correct ?

options.A: Generics are typed subclasses of the classes from the Collections framework.
options.B: Generics are used to parameterize the collections in order to allow for static type checking.
options.C: Generics can be used to perform type checking of the objects in a collection at runtime.
options.D: Generics can be used to iterate over a complete collection in an easy way, using the 'enhanced for' loop.

explanation: Generics parameterise types so the compiler can check types statically; type information is erased at runtime.

question: Which of the following define the rules for .Net Languages?
explanation: The Common Language Specification (CLS) defines the rules .NET languages must follow to interoperate.

question: To get an object of the PrintWriter class, we use the getWriter( ) method of the ______ class.
explanation: response.getWriter() on HttpServletResponse returns a PrintWriter for sending text output.

question: Which of the following is faster and consume lesser memory?
explanation: SqlDataReader is a forward-only, read-only connected stream, so it is faster and lighter than a disconnected DataSet.

question: Which of the following authentications is best suited for a corporate network ?
explanation: Windows authentication uses the existing domain (Active Directory) accounts, which suits intranets/corporate networks.

question: An example of a Network layer is

options.C: Source routing and domain naming - USENET

explanation: IP, X.25 PLP and source routing are all network-layer protocols/mechanisms in their respective networks.

question: ICMP (Internet Control Message Protocol) is :

options.A: A Protocol that handles error and control messages
options.B: A Protocol used to monitor computers

explanation: ICMP carries error reports and control/diagnostic messages for IP.

question: Which is a reserved word in the Java programming language?
explanation: native is a Java keyword marking methods implemented in platform-specific code.

question: Which is valid declaration of a float ?
explanation: 1F is a float literal. 1.0 and 1.0d are double literals and need a cast; a String cannot be assigned to a float.

question: What is numerical range of char ?
explanation: char is an unsigned 16-bit type, from 0 to 65535.

question: Functions and procedures are :

options.A: not useful in designing computer systems
options.B: old fashioned and they are not useful
options.D: have side effects which require special care if they are used as subsystems

explanation: Functions and procedures support modular decomposition and reuse, so they are useful in system design.

question: By polymorphism of a subsystem we mean

options.B: it should have polymorphic data types
options.C: it should accept generic commands and interpret appropriately

explanation: A polymorphic subsystem responds to generic commands and interprets them suitably for the object involved.

question: In UML diagram of a class

options.A: state of object can not be represented
options.C: state is represented as an attribute
options.D: state is represented as a result of an operation

explanation: In a UML class diagram, the state of an object is held in its attributes.

question: A query operation on a object

options.C: changes the state of an object

explanation: A query operation only returns information and does not change the object's state.

question: An exception thrown from outside try block will
explanation: In C++, an exception that is not caught by any handler causes std::terminate() to be called.

question: An exception is caused by

options.B: A problem in the operating system

explanation: Exceptions are raised by abnormal conditions at run time; syntax errors are caught at compile time.

question: In object oriented design

options.B: methods specify algorithm whereas operations only state what is to be done
options.C: methods do not change values of attributes

explanation: An operation is the specification (what is done); a method is its implementation (how, the algorithm).

question: By encapsulation in object oriented modeling we mean

options.B: hiding attributes of an object from users
options.C: hiding operations on object from users
options.D: hiding implementation details of methods from users of objects

explanation: Encapsulation hides how methods are implemented; users interact only through the public interface.

question: Inheritance in object oriented modeling can be used to
explanation: Inheritance supports generalisation (common superclass) and specialisation (subclasses).

question: By polymorphism in object oriented modeling we mean

options.A: the ability to manipulate objects of different distinct classes
options.B: the ability to manipulate objects of different distinct classes knowing only their common properties
options.D: use of similar operations to do similar things

explanation: Polymorphism lets code work with objects of different classes through their common interface/superclass.

question: Which is not an attribute of cookie property ?
explanation: Cookie attributes include path, domain, secure, expires/max-age and HttpOnly; host is not one of them.

question: Overloading the function operator

options.A: requires a class with an overloaded operator
options.B: requires a class with an overloaded( ) operator
options.C: allow you to create objects that act syntactically like functions
options.D: usually make use of a constructor that takes arguments

explanation: Overloading operator() creates function objects (functors) that can be called like functions.

question: Run time polymorphism is achieved by
explanation: Virtual functions give dynamic binding (run-time polymorphism); overloading is resolved at compile time.

question: The members of a class, by default are
explanation: In C++, class members are private by default (struct members are public).

question: A copy constructor takes
explanation: A copy constructor takes one argument, a reference to an object of the same class.

question: A pointer is

options.A: A keyword used to create variables
options.B: A variable that stores address of an instruction
options.C: A variable that stores address of other variable

explanation: A pointer is a variable that holds the memory address of another variable.

question: In visual programming, the icons are the ______ image of an object.
explanation: In visual programming, an icon represents an object both physically (its picture) and logically (its meaning/function).
